contribute.heading: Contribute to {{site}}
checklist: Photograph the site from many angles, with plenty of overlap between consecutive shots.
Use even light, and keep the whole structure in focus.
Several photographs of a large site work better than one wide frame.
Avoid screenshots and heavily compressed photographs.
Keep one site to an upload, so contributions stay separable.
contribute.heicNote: This will be converted to JPEG when it is uploaded.
contribute.fullResHelp: On by default, so your files are sent exactly as the camera wrote them. Turn it off to have them resized first, which uploads faster but loses detail the reconstruction uses.
contribute.fullResLabel: Upload at full resolution (no compression or resizing)
